prompt.description: ACTION + CAMERA + SETTING only. Appearance lives in refs.

dialogue.description: Owner doctrine (2026-08-12, restoring feedback_bake_dialogue + L19): dialogue is BAKED IN from the very beginning. Each entry renders as a scope-bounded L19 lettering block appended to the prompt — clean WHITE 2D bubbles, exact quoted text, identical style every panel. Keep each bubble <= ~8 words; split longer lines across beats. Garbled text = LET-02 blocker; a beat with dialogue entries that renders a blank/empty bubble = LET-01 blocker. Beats with an empty/absent dialogue array must render NO bubbles.

speaker.description: Cast name the bubble tail points to. Omit for captions/SFX.

wardrobe.description: Explicit garment state for this beat (on/off/strained/torn-at-seam...). Chosen to SHOW the body on payoff beats; explicit sleeve behavior on flexes (WARD-07).

stage.description: Growth-tier tag (s1..s5) for continuity + ladder tracking.

beatKind.description: Production budget class: connective = 8 lite variants single round; payoff = 12 variants + refinement round.

variants.description: Per feedback_lite_volume_policy: on nano_banana_2_lite volume is ~free — connective 8, payoff 12. Lean caps only on paid models.
